falsification_conditions.condition: SPY closes below its 20-day moving average for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 73% pattern match to March 2024 ETF rally assumed continued momentum; sustained breakdown below 20DMA invalidates the bullish structure and suggests distribution, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: BLOWOFF SCORE exceeds 75 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score above 75 indicates capitulation/mania rather than measured advance; this would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by confirming terminal euphoria or panic, breaking the pattern's controlled trajectory

falsification_conditions.condition: Aggregate ETF inflows reverse to net outflows exceeding $5B in a single week
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The March 2024 pattern was defined by persistent ETF inflows; net outflows of this magnitude would sever the capital-flow homology and prove the pattern match was spurious

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
